method: read vite.config.ts groqChatProxy handler + one live POST to /api/chat + one independent model-identity probe on the same endpoint

code_findings.middleware: groqChatProxy() in vite.config.ts, mounted at /api/chat via configureServer + configurePreviewServer

headers_set.authorization: Bearer ${GROQ_API_KEY}  (server-side, from loadEnv; never shipped to browser)

code_findings.rewrite_detail: The handler ignores the client request body's `model` entirely and hardcodes `const model = 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile'` (line ~93), sending that as the model to Groq (line ~146). The client's model string never reaches the upstream.
code_findings.response_reshape: Groq's OpenAI-shaped choices[0].message.content is repackaged into Anthropic's { content: [{ type: 'text', text }] } so probe.ts / trace.ts / the eval harness read data.content[0].text unchanged. The reshaped response carries NO model field.
code_findings.note_separate_anthropic_proxy: A distinct anthropic-replay-proxy is mounted at /api/replay (→ https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages, x-api-key from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Only /api/replay talks to Anthropic; /api/chat does not.

messages.content: reply with the single word: confirm

live_request.independent_identity_probe: I am Llama, a model developed by Meta.

decision: KEEP Groq (llama-3.3-70b-versatile) on /api/chat as a deliberate, permanent cost decision — it is the free tier serving Probe and Trace, chosen on purpose (vite.config.ts comment: 'best free option for the structured-JSON reasoning Trace requires; the model the client sends in the request body is ignored on purpose'). It is NOT a leftover from early dev: a separate Anthropic proxy exists at /api/replay for the paid path. Consequence for evals: the `model` constants in lib/probe.ts and lib/trace.ts (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) are cosmetic and ignored by the proxy; every results file must record the actual serving model, 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile via groq', not the request-body id. Follow-up flagged (not done here): align the client-side model constants or add a code comment at each call site so the misleading Haiku id does not confuse future readers.
